artifacts.content:
Type Event
Type Execution { state: Working | Faulted, causalOrder: LamportClock, retryCount: Int }

State IngressQueue: Queue<Event> []
State ReadyQueue: Queue<Execution> []
State IsolatedQueue: Queue<Execution> []

Config maxRetry = 3
Config maxPenaltyRetry = 2

Op Schedule(ReadyQueue) -> Sort(e.causalOrder ASC, FIFO)

Op retry(exec: Execution) -> if exec.retryCount < maxRetry then Requeue(exec) else Abort()

Op retry-with-penalty(exec: Execution) -> Pre(exec.state == Working) -> if exec.retryCount < maxPenaltyRetry then { exec.temp += 0.2; exec.topP -= 0.1 } -> CanonicalState = Immutable -> Requeue(exec) else Abort()

Op abort(event: FaultEvent) -> Terminate(Branch)

INV Schedule == Deterministic(CanonicalState)
INV Retry -> !Mutate(CanonicalState)
INV NormalDialogueExecution !Depends(IsolatedQueue)
INV FaultIsolation -> !Affect(NormalDialogueReplay)

enum ToolEvent = {START, TIMEOUT, ABORT, COMMIT}
type Context = { causal_id: ID }
type State = { canonical: CanonicalState, dialogue: DialogueState }

op apply(evt: ToolEvent) -> State'

INV(authority): State'.canonical != State.canonical <-> evt.type == COMMIT
INV(isolation_fail): evt.type in {TIMEOUT, ABORT} -> State'.dialogue == State.dialogue
INV(causal_id): forall e: ToolEvent, e.causal_id == Context.causal_id

op retry() -> Stream<ToolEvent>
INV(retry_scope): retry() subset_of tool_stream
INV(retry_no_mutation): on(RETRY) -> State.canonical == prev(State.canonical)

INV(no_bypass): evt.type != COMMIT -> State'.canonical == State.canonical
INV(determinism): replay(Events) -> deterministic_outcome

observed_relationships.rationale: Doc Aはオーケストレーション層（スケジューリング・キューイング）を、Doc Bはツールインタラクションの整合性層（状態遷移ルール）を担当するため、Delta3 Kernelにおける関心の分離（Separation of Concerns）を維持する観点から別個に保持すべきである。重複しているCanonicalState不変性の制約は、両モジュールが同じアーキテクチャ原則に従っていることを示すものであり、統合の理由にはならない。
